summary: Read a square table of integers, with as many rows as columns, standing for a picture. Turn the whole picture ninety degrees clockwise and store the result back in the original cells. After the turn, the old first row becomes the rightmost column, and each later row moves in the same fashion. Do not request a second table of equal size to hold the result. The amount of temporary extra cells should stay fixed.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
